svg.title: The best published energies, by system size
svg.desc: Number of sites (x) against relative gap to the exact ground-state energy (y, log scale, better is lower) for 431 published energies and 139 exact energies on 233 exactly solved instances.
svg.text: The best published energies, by system size
431 energies on the 233 instances that have an exact ground-state energy. Results are placed by their relative gap to it so
that different Hamiltonians share one axis. A better energy is lower. Above size 36 there are only Heisenberg and Hubbard
model results. For other Hamiltonians at larger system sizes, see below.
relative gap to the instance's exact energy (better is lower)
